bible.logline: In an empty sunlit Scandinavian apartment, an iconic flat-pack IKEA box violently trembles, then mechanically unpacks and self-assembles into a pristine, serene living sanctuary with hyper-tactile ASMR foley.

environment.spatial_architecture: An expansive 8x6 meter open-plan apartment with ultra-smooth pale blonde ash hardwood floors, matte-white limewashed walls, and floor-to-ceiling multi-pane Nordic windows on the left wall looking out to quiet birch trees.
environment.lighting_setup: Soft, low-angled morning Scandinavian sunlight streaming through the windows at 5200K daylight balance, casting elongated warm rectangular light pools across the floor, filled with soft 6500K ambient room bounce.
environment.atmospheric_particles: Delicate, slow-drifting micro-motes of atmospheric dust illuminated in the light beam; zero haze, zero smoke.
positive_invariants: The pale blonde ash floorboards remain mechanically rigid with realistic wood grain that never distorts or changes direction.
The walls remain pristine matte-white with consistent architectural baseboards.
All furniture pieces retain exact Scandinavian minimalist geometry and color-true IKEA fabrics once assembled.

camera_rig.rig_type: Locked-off Studio Tripod on 35mm Prime Lens
camera_rig.composition: Wide-angle eye-level architectural framing showing 80% of the room with the flat-pack box dead-center.
camera_rig.route: Completely locked-off static camera for the entire duration with zero drift, zero pan, and zero handheld shake.
camera_rig.action_anchor: Static frame holds observational discipline while hyper-kinetic assembly erupts within it.
camera_rig.focus_axis: Deep f/8 depth of field keeping the center box and back walls tack-sharp.

foley_cues: Low resonant cardboard vibration on wood floor
Sharp, satisfying high-frequency tape tear and cardboard seam pop
Crisp wood dowel clicks, rapid mechanical drawer slide swooshes, and solid pine locking thuds
Soft, airy, deep 'fwoomp' of down-filled textiles settling onto wood
Pristine, dead-silent room tone with gentle morning bird chirps outside glass
sonic_blueprint.room_acoustics: Bright, reverberant empty wooden room acoustics during the initial box opening, transitioning smoothly into a warm, dampened, acoustically insulated soundscape as fabrics, rugs, and cushions populate the space.

instrumentation: Felted upright piano playing delicate sparse arpeggios
Subtle wooden xylophone clicks tuned to foley impacts
Warm analog sub-bass drone resolving into absolute stillness
master_bgm.dynamic_arc: Seconds 00-08: Tense, playful pizzicato rhythm ticking like a clockwork box. Seconds 08-16: Rapid, polyrhythmic wooden mallet pulses synchronizing with furniture clicks. Seconds 16-24: Swelling warm cello and piano harmony. Seconds 24-32: All music decrescendos instantly on the final blanket drop, leaving only a sustained pure piano chord and serene silence.
master_bgm.lyria_prompt: Minimalist Scandinavian ASMR neo-classical acoustic cue, 84 BPM, D Major. Opens with delicate plucked cello pizzicato and light woodblock clicks. Builds into an intricate, satisfying, rhythmic clockwork pattern with felted upright piano. Resolves gracefully into a lush, peaceful ambient string chord that rings out into pristine silence.

action_beats: The sealed IKEA box sits dead-center on the bare ash floor in total stillness under morning sunlight.
At second 03, the box begins to shudder rapidly with high-frequency tactile micro-vibrations.
At second 07, the reinforced packing tape along the top center seam suddenly splits open with a crisp pop and a tiny puff of kraft paper dust.
scenes.kinetic_contact_chain: Stillness -> Micro-oscillation of box edges against ash floorboards -> High-tension seam split -> Cardboard flaps spring open 15 degrees -> Settles into open posture.
scenes.omni_prose_prompt: A locked-off wide-angle architectural shot captures an empty, pristine Scandinavian room with pale blonde ash wood floors and sunlit white walls, based on the spatial layout of <image_2>. In the exact dead-center of the floor rests a sealed kraft cardboard IKEA flat-pack box matching the design in <image_1>. All action occurs at natural, real-time 1.0x playback speed with unyielding physical gravity. For the first three seconds, the box sits in dead stillness under warm morning sunlight streaming through the tall left windows. At second 03, the box begins to tremble and vibrate with intense, tactile micro-tremors, rattling crisply against the rigid hardwood floor without shifting location. At second 07, the center packing tape violently splits open, releasing a small puff of kraft dust as the top cardboard flaps spring slightly upward. The camera remains completely fixed on its tripod with zero movement, zero drift, and tack-sharp deep focus. Synchronized diegetic audio begins with dead-silent empty room tone, followed by the dry resonant woody rattling of cardboard against ash flooring, culminating in a sharp, hyper-tactile cardboard POP and tearing tape sound.
conversational_edit_deltas: Turn 2: Make the box tremble more violently and add visible paper dust curling into the sunbeam.
Turn 3: Change the morning sun to soft overcast afternoon daylight while keeping the box action identical.

action_beats: The cardboard flaps fold flat onto the floor like blooming origami petals.
Precision-cut solid oak furniture legs, white shelf panels, and frame components levitate out in structured order.
Components interlock at high velocity into a low coffee table and a minimalist shelving unit with rigid mechanical clicks.
scenes.kinetic_contact_chain: Flaps burst outward -> Wooden pieces slide on air trajectories -> Dovetail joints collide and snap together -> Base legs strike the hardwood floor with solid acoustic thuds -> Stable resting lock.
scenes.omni_prose_prompt: A locked-off wide-angle architectural shot from the exact same fixed camera position in the empty Scandinavian room. Continuing at 1.0x real-time speed with no slow motion, the cardboard box flaps instantly burst fully open, laying flat on the blonde ash floor. In a rapid, hyper-satisfying burst of choreographed kinetic assembly, flat-pack components derived from <image_3> erupt in crisp sequence: precision-cut solid oak table legs shoot outward and lock with rigid mechanical authority into an oval coffee table tabletop, while white-lacquered shelf panels slide and click into a vertical bookcase against the rear wall. Every wooden dowel, joint, and cam-lock snaps into place with zero elastic warping or rubbery bending, obeying rigid solid-state geometry. The camera holds perfectly static on its tripod, framing the explosive self-building choreography in tack-sharp focus. Synchronized diegetic ASMR audio features a rapid cascade of hyper-detailed mechanical sounds: high-speed sliding wood panels, sharp rhythmic CLICK-CLACK dowel snaps, metallic fastener clicks, and the deep, solid THUD of oak table legs planting firmly onto the hardwood floorboards, accompanied by playful acoustic cello pizzicato from the master score.
conversational_edit_deltas: Turn 2: Increase the speed of the shelf assembly and add subtle sawdust motes catching the sunlight.
Turn 3: Ensure the bookcase locks against the wall with an audible resonant tap.
